title: The Genesis Capital Backstop currently executes through Executive Votes and must wait out the governance security delay
content:
A.3.7.1.6.1 records the implementation gap plainly: "In the near term, transfers are made through Executive Votes and may be made through Emergency Spells... as part of the Emergency Response System. A solution must be developed to allow these transfers to be accomplished on an automated basis without waiting for the GSM Pause Delay."

This puts a manual, delay-bound process at the front of a loss waterfall whose later stages are automatic. A.3.6 makes the SKY Backstop mint "automatically" on undercollateralization, and A.3.6.6 forbids invoking it "unless the Genesis Capital Backstop has been applied and USDS remains undercollateralized." So the automatic stage is gated behind a stage that today requires a vote to pass and a Governance Security Module delay to elapse.

The consequence is a timing mismatch in exactly the scenario the mechanism exists for. Losses that breach a Prime Agent's capital arrive at market speed; the remedy arrives at governance speed. During the interval USDS may be undercollateralized with the first line of defence legally required but not yet applied, and the Emergency Spell path is the only compression available — which is why the Atlas points at it as a stopgap while asking for automation.

The GSM Pause Delay exists to protect holders from malicious governance actions, so removing it for this specific transfer means designing a path that is fast and yet cannot be repurposed to seize Agent assets. That the Atlas states the requirement without specifying the solution marks this as an open, load-bearing item in the Endgame transition.
description: Haircut transfers are made by Executive Vote or Emergency Spell today, and the Atlas states a solution must be developed to automate them without waiting for the GSM Pause Delay.
